product_summary: Website (jainexsteelimpex.com, live, checked 2026) lists: stainless steel sheets & plates (grades 201/202/301/304/304H/304L/316/316L/409L/409M/410S/430/441/JSL AUS); stainless steel slitting coil; stainless steel strip (same grade range); stainless steel foil; round bar (SS 201/202/316/316L/410S/430/409L/409M, duplex 2205/S31803, super duplex 32750/32760, nickel 200/201, Monel K500, Inconel 601/825, Hastelloy C276); pipes & tubes; shims; binding wire. Also nickel-alloy and titanium strip (Ti Gr 1/2/5). Self-description: 'importers, stockiest & suppliers' with an 'integrated steel complex' for slitting/processing.
role_hint: trader (self-described importer/stockist/supplier; claims processing/slitting facilities — possible manufacturer_trader, not verifiable from public pages)
comment: Declared HS 7220.20 = flat-rolled stainless steel, cold-rolled, width <600 mm — this is exactly the core product line (SS cold-rolled strip / slitting coil / foil), so the declaration is corroborated by the catalogue: partial match, not wrong. However the declared single code covers only a fraction of the actual range. Missing from the declaration: (1) wide flat-rolled SS sheet/plate ≥600 mm — 7219.33/34/35 (cold-rolled 304/316) and 7219.11/12/22/23 (hot-rolled); (2) hot-rolled narrow strip 7220.11/7220.90; (3) nickel-alloy products — Monel/Inconel/Hastelloy strip, foil, bar: 7506.20 (nickel-alloy sheet/strip/foil), 7505.12/7505.22 (nickel bars/profiles), 7505.11/7505.21 (Monel = Ni-Cu alloy); (4) titanium strip/bar 8108.90; (5) SS seamless/welded pipe & tube 7304.41/7304.49/7306.40; (6) binding wire 7317.00; (7) shims 7326.90 (or 7318 if bolt-type). Industry classification 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' is broadly correct for steel flat products but misleading for the nickel/titanium alloy trading line — this is a metals stockist/trader, not a miner. Trader signs: 'importers, stockiest & suppliers', no plant address (registered/contact address is a residential flat in Khetwadi, Mumbai), no GST/manufacturing licence shown, no capacity figures — the 'integrated steel complex' claim is marketing text only. Per project rule 3, HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, code corrected/expanded to the actual product range. All product lines above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, B/L or invoice was checked in this task (out of scope), so no shipment or volume facts are asserted here.
